scope.reason: The post-fork fd/exec-status/signal boundary and bounded OS cleanup are not established by pure state-machine review. Use the explicitly allowed model fallback; do not substitute caller booleans for live identity.
scope.outcome: All model reports have live_verified=false, publication=false, stop_required=true. SettledModel only means synthetic lifecycle input satisfied the model. PR30 uses binding=None; no worker-reported classification or protocol success is promoted to live evidence.

range.input: Owned synthetic Box<[u8]>, 22 bytes to 16 MiB. No file snapshot acquisition or atomic capture claim.

channels.stdout: ZIP2 handled only by PR30 Session
channels.stderr: 48-byte ZXR2 binary range requests only; never text logging
channels.stdin: 64-byte ZXE2 then exact echoed request header and snapshot payload

range.config: ZXE2/version=2/JobId/input length/processed/output/entries/100ns duration ticks; matches worker caps. Duration below one tick rejected; fractional ticks rounded down.
range.requests: Validate magic/version, nonzero matching JobId, sequence from 0, reserved zero, count 1..65536, checked offset+count within snapshot; reserve count and served bytes before response.
range.memory: One header[48] and one Reply cursor at a time. Reply payload borrows immutable owned snapshot; no second response or payload copy.
range.backpressure: request_capacity is zero until configuration or current response is fully written. Adapter must limit each read to request_capacity; coalesced/pipelined requests rejected in this fixed one-request worker profile.
range.writes: outbound returns one remaining header or payload slice. written accepts only positive actual-write count within that slice. EAGAIN/EINTR do not advance progress; zero write is a fault.
range.eof: At request boundary accepted only after config and pending response complete. Partial header and outstanding reply are distinct faults. abort discards pending response without claiming bytes sent or EOF.

reactor.provenance: All observation methods and elapsed values are synthetic inputs to a model, not a public proof API for a running child. No live entry point accepts PID, EOF, cleanup or observed hash options.
reactor.deadlines: Launch, operation and cleanup each bounded to 0<duration<=300s. begin_turn uses monotonically increasing modeled elapsed Duration. A future adapter must derive this from Instant, not external input. Exec-status boundary EOF starts operation; observed reap starts bounded drain. First stop starts cleanup; later causes cannot extend it.
reactor.fairness: Each begin_turn checks cancellation then deadline before replenishing quotas. Per-turn stdout and stdin quotas are 16384 bytes each, stderr 48, exec-status 4. Poll slice <=50ms; same-turn cancellation wins the defined observation tie. Earlier failure remains latched.
reactor.data: stdout uses PR30 without copying validator and is discarded after validation. Stopping may drain stderr under quota without declaring those bytes valid range requests.
reactor.first_cause: ModelReport.first retains detailed raw/range/reactor/exec/cancel/deadline reason. Range/reactor errors cannot fit PR30 HostCause precisely and are represented there as supervisor Io (Budget for range budget); detailed model reason is authoritative for this model.
reactor.kill: request_kill is generated by explicit first failure/deadline state only, never by PR30's ordinary in-progress stop_required. kill_result(true) records only modeled signal acceptance and never reap.
reactor.cleanup: All stdout/stderr/exec EOF observations, stdin closure, wait observation and fd closure are required before SettledModel. Closing readers is not EOF. Missing confirmations, kill/reap failure or cleanup expiry stay Blocked/CleanupFailed. No next-case reset is provided.
reactor.supervisor_gap: This state machine does not prove read==0, wait status, fd closure, real time, ownership or child containment. Signalled/Exited observations remain synthetic.
inherited_limits: PR30 malformed decoder cause loss unchanged
no CRC/ZIP decode/expected item count proof
no source processed-byte or compression ratio enforcement beyond worker config
reactor.post_reap_range: Buffered range bytes after modeled reap fail as OutstandingResponse before creating a reply that cannot be sent. Drain continues under cleanup quota; no kill of a reaped child.
